done-label.description: Summary text when done and elapsed time is unavailable.

duration.description: Optional elapsed milliseconds. Done displays finite, nonnegative values rounded to seconds.

duration-label.description: Summary template for zero or multiple elapsed seconds. The {seconds} placeholder receives the rounded time.

open.description: Whether the disclosure shows its steps. Native toggles update this reflected property.

singular-duration-label.description: Summary template for one elapsed second. The {seconds} placeholder receives the rounded time.

status.description: Use thinking while steps arrive and done once the assistant finishes.

thinking-label.description: Summary text while the assistant is thinking.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-reasoning-backdrop-filter.description: Complete filter behind the disclosure. None keeps the backdrop clear.

--ki-reasoning-bg.description: Fill behind the disclosure summary and its steps.

--ki-reasoning-bg-image.description: Optional image painted over the disclosure fill.

--ki-reasoning-body-gap.description: Block spacing between the summary and the step content.

--ki-reasoning-body-indent.description: Inline spacing between the rule and the content.

--ki-reasoning-border.description: Ink of the decorative rule at the inline start of the steps.

--ki-reasoning-fg.description: Medium-emphasis ink for the disclosure summary and its steps.

--ki-reasoning-list-indent.description: Inline space for markers on a slotted list.

--ki-reasoning-shimmer-easing.description: Easing into and out of the thinking highlight.

--ki-reasoning-shimmer-fg.description: Readable highlight at the midpoint of the thinking shimmer.

--ki-reasoning-summary-gap.description: Space between the summary text and glyphs and between separate step blocks.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-para.description: semantic dimension for typography line height para.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size.description: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.

component.description: A disclosure for the assistant's progress or plan, with a localized summary.

ki-toggle.description: Emitted after a native disclosure toggle. Setting open from the application is silent.

body.description: The slotted content area with the inline-start rule.

summary.description: The native disclosure control that shows the current status.

doneLabel.description: Summary text when done and elapsed time is unavailable.

duration.description: Optional elapsed milliseconds. Done displays finite, nonnegative values rounded to seconds.

durationLabel.description: Summary template for zero or multiple elapsed seconds. The {seconds} placeholder receives the rounded time.

open.description: Whether the disclosure shows its steps. Native toggles update this reflected property.

singularDurationLabel.description: Summary template for one elapsed second. The {seconds} placeholder receives the rounded time.

status.description: Use thinking while steps arrive and done once the assistant finishes.

thinkingLabel.description: Summary text while the assistant is thinking.

slots.description: Supporting content shown when expanded, such as an ordered list of steps supplied by the application.
